correctness.rationale: The normalized arbelos has unique ordered diameter tip pairs, and exact circle inequalities show x displacements scale as epsilon and vertical displacements as sqrt(epsilon. The limiting positive 4D integral is finite; inclusion-exclusion and one elementary q integral reduce it to explicit arctangents. The area normalization and two ordered maximizers give the final coefficient. Independent numerical Simpson evaluation agrees with closed form; finite-deficit quadrature approaches it. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The arbelos is a historical canonical three-semicircle geometry whose nonconvex parabolic-cusp vertices create a natural diameter-tail problem not captured by smooth convex endpoints. An exact all-ratio arctangent law and singular thin-shape amplitude specify a nontrivial natural metric statistic, with clear use as an endpoint benchmark for random geometric sampling.
